title: Substitution for Member at Sagaing Regional Investment Committee
text:
The Republic of the Union of Myanmar
Myanmar Investment Commission
Notification No. 1 / 2020
th
6 Waning of Pyatho, 1381 M.E
th
30 January, 2020
Substitution for Member at Sagaing Regional Investment Committee
U Win Hlaing, Director, the Planning Department has been appointed as the
member of the Sagaing Regional Investment Committee which was formed by the
notification No. (55/ 2017) of the Myanmar Investment Commission.
